target.title: fix(sessions): reject altered visible message cursors
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where visible-message pagination accepted altered variants of OpenClaw-issued continuation cursors. Appended junk, base64url padding, and extra JSON fields could all resume from the same SQLite transcript position as the canonical cursor, and extra fields were copied into the next emitted cursor.

## Why This Change Was Made

Visible-message cursors now require both their base64url bytes and their complete decoded envelope to round-trip exactly to OpenClaw's existing encoder output. Pagination queries, cursor fields, reset reasons, and the SQLite schema are unchanged. The compatibility risk is that cursor aliases previously accepted as continuation hints now take the existing reset path; canonical OpenClaw-issued cursors are unchanged.

## User Impact

Malformed or structurally altered visible-message cursors now return the existing `invalid_cursor` reset instead of silently continuing from an equivalent position. Canonical cursors emitted by OpenClaw continue to page normally.

## Evidence

On Node v24.18.0, I drove the real `readSessionTranscriptVisibleMessageDelta()` SDK runtime against a real temporary SQLite transcript store with `node --import tsx --input-type=module -e '<production-path harness>'`. The harness created a session, appended a real transcript message, read an OpenClaw-issued cursor, and then supplied that cursor unchanged and in three altered forms. `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` and the session store were isolated to temporary proof directories.

Before, using unmodified `upstream/main` production code, every cursor variant continued as a page, and the extra field was re-emitted:

```text
{"name":"canonical","kind":"page","reason":null,"emittedExtra":false}
{"name":"appendedJunk","kind":"page","reason":null,"emittedExtra":false}
{"name":"padding","kind":"page","reason":null,"emittedExtra":false}
{"name":"extraField","kind":"page","reason":null,"emittedExtra":true}
```

After the fix, canonical continuation still works while all altered variants take the existing reset path:

```text
{"name":"canonical","kind":"page","reason":null}
{"name":"appendedJunk","kind":"reset","reason":"invalid_cursor"}
{"name":"padding","kind":"reset","reason":"invalid_cursor"}
{"name":"extraField","kind":"reset","reason":"invalid_cursor"}
```

The focused production-SDK regression passes and retains the existing canonical two-page continuation coverage:

```text
OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugin-sdk/session-transcript-runtime-visible-delta.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       2 passed (2)
```

Also passed: targeted `oxfmt --check`, `git diff --check`, the native state schema-version guard (`v5`), and final Codex autoreview (`patch is correct`, confidence 0.94, no actionable findings).

No live agent turn was run; the affected behavior is fully exercised through the production SDK runtime and a real SQLite store without substituting the cursor parser or database path.

AI-assisted: Codex helped implement and review the change; the production-path proof and focused test were run in the contributor worktree.
